docs.content: To read a score, call `getCreditScore`; to build a summary, call `generateReport`.
Call `getUserScore` to compute the credit score for a user.
`getRiskLevel` returns the risk tier. `computeScore` was the legacy entry point.
Call `getCreditLimit` to read the approved limit for an account.
Older integrations call `fetchLimits` before every purchase.
Use `listPayments` to see every payment on an order, and `getCreditScore` for the score.
`getPayments` returns the payments made in the last month.
`sendReminder` emails the customer three days before the due date.
When a payment is late, `notifyUser` sends the first notice and `getRiskTier` updates the tier.
Run `exportCsv` to download the monthly summary as a spreadsheet.
